name: Commission for the Arts Special Meeting
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts Special Meeting
AGENDA
OCTOBER 6, 2025 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
COMMUNITY WORKSHOP: ARTS ELEMENT IN THE ENCINITAS GENERAL PLAN (Times are approximate and subject to change.)
A.
Welcome & Introduction (5 minutes)
B.
Context & Key Facts (15 minutes)
1.
Commission presentation (Attachment 1):
a.
What is the General Plan (available online: https://bit.ly/coegeneralplan)
b.
What is an Arts Master Plan (Attachment 2), and how this work is different
c.
Encinitas arts history (brief highlights)
d.
Examples of arts goals from other cities (Attachment 3)
e.
Encinitas Public Art Policy (Attachment 4)
f.
Encinitas Public Visual Art Policy (Attachment 5)
g.
What City Council directed the Commission to do
Attachment 1 - Commission presentation
Attachment 2 - Arts Master Plan
Attachment 3 - Arts goals from other cities
Attachment 4 - Encinitas Public Art Policy
Attachment 5 - Encinitas Public Visual Art Policy
C.
Small Group Brainstorm – Round 1 (20 minutes)
1.
Prompts:
a.
“What do you value about Encinitas’s cultural life now?”
b.
“What do you want it to become?”
D.
Large Group Share – Round 1 (20 minutes)
1.
One person from each small group reads their lists to the room
2.
Chair/commissioner records top “values” and ”becomes.”
3.
Brief group discussion: “What do you notice? What’s missing?”
E.
Small Group Brainstorm – Round 2 (20 minutes)
1.
Prompt: “What big-picture goals should guide the arts in Encinitas for the next 25–50 years?”
a.
Scribe records all ideas
b.
Groups fill out “5-8 Priority Goal” Sheet (Attachment 6)
Attachment 6 - Priority Goal Sheet
F.
Large Group Share – Round 2 (20 minutes)
1.
One person from each small groups share the most agreed upon goals
2.
Chair/commissioner records top goals
3.
Brief group discussion: “What do you notice? What resonates? What’s missing?”
G.
Break (10 minutes)
1.
During break: Commissioners write 1 goal per large sheet and stick around the room
H.
Room Walk and Voting: Goal Refinement (10 minutes)
1.
Participants walk the room & mark their top 5–8 goals
I.
Closing & Next Steps (10 minutes)
1.
Chair shares what will happen with the input.
2.
Commission asks groups to fill out Workshop evaluations
A.
Welcome & Introduction (5 minutes)
1.
One person from each small group reads their lists to the room
ADJOURNMENT
ADJOURNMENT
